home.name: 假鬼社
home.en: a university club in Chengdu that investigates hauntings: every ghost so far has been someone with a reason

le.name: 阿乐
le.en: the club's loudest member: brave, until something moves

guo.name: 果果
guo.en: films it all on a phone held very still

baozi.name: 包子
baozi.en: the club's cat: runs from every ghost, finds every clue

jiang.name: 蒋叔
jiang.en: owner of 老蒋火锅, a hot-pot restaurant with a ghost

fang.name: 小芳
fang.en: a delivery rider who brings 蒋叔 his late supper

deng.name: 邓阿姨
deng.en: the KTV's night cleaner; sang once, for a living

he.name: 何经理
he.en: the KTV's manager: tired, and sure it's haunted

xu.name: 老许
xu.en: a regular: calls himself the king of songs

zhong.name: 小钟
zhong.en: a student cramming for 考研 who never leaves the library

qishou.name: 骑手
qishou.en: a courier in a black hood, head down, who rides the campus at night

laoban.name: 烧烤摊老板
laoban.en: runs the late-night barbecue stall by the dorms

ke.name: 柯老师
ke.en: the club's first president, now the campus vet
